title: Mexican Wilted Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines wilted greens with the warmth of Mexican spices. Wrap it up for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Herbal Guacamole
ingredients.notes: made with fresh herbs and lime juice

ingredients.name: Portuguese-Style Spicy Salsa
ingredients.notes: made with red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime juice

ingredients.name: Roasted Sweet Potato
ingredients.notes: diced and roasted with olive oil and cumin

ingredients.name: Black Beans
ingredients.notes: cooked with cumin and chili powder

ingredients.name: Sliced Radishes
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and sprinkled with lime juice

instructions: Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the wilted greens, roasted sweet potato, black beans, and sliced radishes onto the center of the tortilla.
Drizzle the herbal guacamole and Portuguese-style spicy salsa on top of the filling.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top for garnish.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
